senses.definition: affectedly modest or shy especially in a playful or provocative way
showing marked and often playful or irritating evasiveness or reluctance to make a definite or committing statement
examples: a politician coy about his intentions

senses.definition: modestly or warily rejecting approaches or overtures
examples: like a wild young colt, very inquisitive but very coy and not to be easily cajoled

senses.definition: offspring of a coyote and a dog

examples: she pouted and looked at him coyly
